<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#f7f0e6">
<title>Sea Breeze Hotel | Ambalangoda, Sri Lanka</title>
<meta name="description" content="Sea Breeze Hotel — a beachfront stay in Ambalangoda on Sri Lanka's southern coast, with rooms, gardens, dining and event spaces.">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#18201f;
  --muted:#65706c;
  --paper:#f7f0e6;
  --paper2:#fffaf2;
  --white:#ffffff;
  --sun:#d85832;
  --sun2:#e87a43;
  --gold:#bf945c;
  --ocean:#0d6470;
  --forest:#254b3f;
  --line:rgba(24,32,31,.14);
  --shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(32,37,35,.14);
  --serif:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --sans:Inter,ui-sans-serif,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper2);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);line-height:1.6;overflow-x:hidden}
body.modal-open{overflow:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button,a{font:inherit}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{cursor:pointer}
::selection{background:#f6c9b6;color:#101817}
.wrap{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 42px));margin-inline:auto}
.eyebrow{font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:var(--sun);margin:0 0 16px}
.eyebrow.light{color:#ffe1c6}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;line-height:1.03;margin:0}
h2{font-size:clamp(2.5rem,5vw,5rem);letter-spacing:-.035em}
h3{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.2vw,2rem)}
p{margin:0}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid transparent;padding:14px 22px;min-height:48px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.88rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;transition:.25s ease}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-sun{background:var(--sun);color:white;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(216,88,50,.26)}
.btn-sun:hover{background:#c94e2b}
.btn-ghost{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.56);color:white;background:rgba(20,27,26,.12);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.btn-dark{background:var(--ink);color:white}
.btn-outline{border-color:var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.text-link{font-weight:800;font-size:.84rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;padding-bottom:4px}

/* Loader */
.preloader{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--paper);z-index:9999;transition:.5s ease}
.preloader.is-gone{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
.preloader-mark{width:110px;animation:pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.7}}

/* Header */
.site-header{position:fixed;z-index:1000;top:0;left:0;right:0;padding:16px 0;transition:.35s ease}
.header-shell{width:min(1260px,calc(100% - 28px));margin:auto;height:74px;padding:0 12px 0 18px;border-radius:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;background:rgba(255,250,242,.93);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);box-shadow:0 12px 50px rgba(20,30,28,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:208px}
.brand img{width:204px;height:auto;max-height:50px;object-fit:contain}
.desktop-nav{display:flex;gap:24px;margin-left:auto;align-items:center}
.desktop-nav a{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.085em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#2d3936;position:relative}
.desktop-nav a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-7px;height:2px;width:0;background:var(--sun);transition:.25s}
.desktop-nav a:hover:after{width:100%}
.header-cta{padding:12px 19px;min-height:44px}
.menu-btn{display:none;margin-left:auto;border:0;background:transparent;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;position:relative}
.menu-btn span{position:absolute;left:11px;right:11px;height:2px;background:var(--ink);transition:.25s}
.menu-btn span:first-child{top:17px} .menu-btn span:last-child{top:25px}
.mobile-panel{position:fixed;z-index:999;top:0;right:0;width:min(390px,88vw);height:100dvh;background:var(--paper2);padding:110px 28px 30px;transform:translateX(104%);transition:.36s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.25,1);box-shadow:-30px 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.mobile-panel.is-open{transform:none}
.mobile-panel a,.mobile-panel button{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:16px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:none;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.55rem}
.mobile-scrim{position:fixed;z-index:998;inset:0;background:rgba(8,15,14,.48);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.3s}
.mobile-scrim.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}

/* Hero */
.hero{height:100svh;min-height:720px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#101716}
.hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:var(--hero);background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:0;transform:scale(1.055);transition:opacity 1.15s ease,transform 7s ease;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.hero-slide.is-active{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}
.hero-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,16,15,.78) 0%,rgba(10,16,15,.45) 43%,rgba(10,16,15,.06) 75%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(8,14,13,.52),transparent 45%)}
.hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:2;color:white;padding-bottom:clamp(90px,12vh,140px);padding-top:160px}
.hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,7.8rem);max-width:900px;letter-spacing:-.055em;text-wrap:balance;text-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.hero-sub{max-width:570px;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.7vw,1.25rem);margin-top:22px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.86)}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}
.hero-controls{position:absolute;z-index:5;right:max(24px,calc((100vw - 1180px)/2));bottom:42px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:white}
.hero-count{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.15rem;min-width:56px}
.hero-dots{display:flex;gap:7px}
.hero-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);padding:0}
.hero-dot.is-active{width:26px;border-radius:9px;background:white}
.hero-arrow{width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.44);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,25,24,.15);color:white;font-size:1.3rem;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.hero-badge{position:absolute;right:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1180px)/2));top:138px;z-index:4;color:white;text-align:right}
.hero-badge strong{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:500;display:block}
.hero-badge span{font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.2em;opacity:.8}
.coast-line{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:54px;color:var(--paper2)}

/* Sections */
.section{padding:clamp(88px,10vw,150px) 0}
.section-intro{max-width:780px;margin-bottom:58px}
.section-intro p:not(.eyebrow){font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:650px;margin-top:18px}
